title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1969-12-07
lineage: SBD > MC > DAT > CDR > EAC > DCart Millennium > CDR

ai_review.summary: Fair‑muddy soundboard capture of the historic day‑after‑Altamont show, highlighted by a scorching China Cat and an epic 28‑minute Turn On Your Lovelight.
ai_review.review: The performance is steeped in the somber mood of December 7, 1969, delivering inspired playing that many fans cite as classic ’69 Dead—especially the fiery China Cat, the St. Stephen → The Eleven sequence and Pigpen’s marathon Turn On Your Lovelight. While the soundboard source is noticeably muddy and benefits from an EQ boost, it remains listenable enough to convey the show’s historic weight.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the musical performance (average 4‑5 stars) despite consistent complaints about muddy, hissy sound; combining strong show quality with fair recording yields a solid 4.2 rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Muddy and slightly hissy tape‑derived audio; lacks brightness, but overall listenable with EQ adjustments.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A heavy, post‑Altamont atmosphere dominates the early set (sorrowful Black Peter, subdued Hard to Handle) before lifting into brighter numbers like Cumberland Blues and Mama Tried, culminating in an ecstatic Lovelight finale.
